name: Upbit Larry Williams K=0.5 daily volatility breakout
author: InvestFactCheck
instruments_timeframes: Upbit KRW-BTC daily bars; article defines bars at 09:00 KST.
indicators: K=0.5; previous daily range = prior high - prior low; buy trigger = current daily open + 0.5 * previous daily range.
entry_long: Place/buy at the current day's open plus half the previous day's high-low range; the article counts a fill at that trigger if the current daily high reaches it.
exit: Sell at the next daily bar's open. Same-day close is described as a tested alternative, not the base rule.
position_sizing: Not specified for the single-instrument Upbit example.
filters: No market regime filter; one-day holding horizon. Article reports 0.05% per-side Upbit costs for the tested run.
claimed_performance: Article reports Upbit bitcoin 43.1% annual return, -50.1% max drawdown, and 46.7% win rate for 2017-09 onward through 2026-10-30, after stated costs. This is the article's backtest result, not independently reproduced; it assumes exact trigger fills when a daily high touches the level and zero slippage.
implementation_notes: Explicit daily entry and next-open exit are documented. Daily OHLC cannot establish intraday queue/fill quality; the article assumes a fill exactly at the trigger when high reaches it. Upbit day boundary is 09:00 KST. Performance is sensitive to venue and price feed.
